Guidance & outlook: Total income for the quarter stood at INR 287.70 crores as compared to INR 240.86 crores in quarter three FY26, registering a growth of 19.45 percentage quarter-on-quarter.

Net profit for quarter four FY26 stood at INR 12.37 crores as against INR 2.28 crores in quarter three financial year 2026, registering a strong growth of 442.80% quarter-on-quarter, while net profit margin improved by 335 basis points to 4.30%.
For the full year FY26, the company reported total income of INR 1,066.42 crores, EBITDA of INR 138.03 crores, and net profit of INR 26.99 crores.
Growth & demand: FY26 has been an important and progressive year for Steel Exchange India Limited as we continued to strengthen our operational capabilities, improve financial flexibility, and build a stronger foundation for long-term sustainable growth.
At the same time, the company undertook several strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing governance, improving capital structure, and creating a scalable platform for future growth.

Steel Exchange India Limited May 28, 2026 EBITDA increased significantly to INR 50.10 crores from INR 22.97 crores in quarter three financial year 2026, reflecting a robust growth of 118.12 percentage sequentially.
